causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: At around 2 pm a catastrophic failure of Callide C unit 4 reduced the amount of low priced capacity available to the market Callide B, Callide C, Stanwell and Gladstone Power Stations either went offline or had their output reduced.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: There was already over 2,300 MW of baseload generation in Queensland and 2,600 MW in NSW unavailable, mainly due to planned outages.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: Multiple significant transmission lines around Callide tripped.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: There was a planned outage of lines in NSW for the upgrade of the Queensland to NSW interconnector (QNI) which limited Queensland's ability to import cheaper generation from NSW.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: Imports into NSW across the Vic-NSW interconnector were limited to around 570 MW (nominally 1,400 MW) by planned outages around Canberra and South Morang in Victoria.

causes.label: solar_output
causes.quote: Due to the low amount of thermal capacity on in Queensland after the Callide incident, at around 2.15 pm constraints used to manage system strength reduced the output of solar and wind farms in Queensland.

causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: Due to the low amount of thermal capacity on in Queensland after the Callide incident, at around 2.15 pm constraints used to manage system strength reduced the output of solar and wind farms in Queensland.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: Arrow Energy at Braemar 2 and CleanCo at Wivenhoe rebid capacity to above $5,000/MWh for part of the 4.30 pm trading interval which contributed to a high price at 4.20 pm before Arrow Energy rebid capacity back down to the price floor.

constraints_named.quote: Due to the low amount of thermal capacity on in Queensland after the Callide incident, at around 2.15 pm constraints used to manage system strength reduced the output of solar and wind farms in Queensland.

interconnectors_named.name: Queensland to NSW interconnector (QNI)
interconnectors_named.quote: There was a planned outage of lines in NSW for the upgrade of the Queensland to NSW interconnector (QNI) which limited Queensland's ability to import cheaper generation from NSW.

interconnectors_named.name: Vic-NSW interconnector
interconnectors_named.quote: Imports into NSW across the Vic-NSW interconnector were limited to around 570 MW (nominally 1,400 MW) by planned outages around Canberra and South Morang in Victoria.

interconnectors_named.name: Terranora interconnector
interconnectors_named.quote: Upgrades to QNI meant lines were out in NSW, limiting flows to Queensland to 700 MW (nominally 1,000 MW) while system normal constraints were limiting imports across the Terranora interconnector to around 60 MW (nominally 107 MW).

intervals.quote: On 25 May 2021 the spot price in Queensland exceeded $5,000/MWh for the 4.30 pm to 6.30 pm trading intervals and in NSW for the 5.30 pm trading interval.
intervals.text: Queensland: 4.30 pm to 6.30 pm trading intervals; NSW: 5.30 pm trading interval

network_outages.quote: Multiple significant transmission lines around Callide tripped.

peak_price.quote: The spot price in Queensland ranged between $4,988/MWh and $15,000/MWh for the 4.30 pm to 7 pm trading intervals

rebid_set_price.quote: Arrow Energy at Braemar 2 and CleanCo at Wivenhoe rebid capacity to above $5,000/MWh for part of the 4.30 pm trading interval which contributed to a high price at 4.20 pm before Arrow Energy rebid capacity back down to the price floor.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: Imports from Victoria over the VIC-NSW interconnector were around 570 MW, about a third of its nominal limit, due to planned network outages in NSW and Victoria. This meant NSW could not access any more low priced capacity from Victoria.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: There was already over 2,300 MW of baseload generation in Queensland and 2,600 MW in NSW unavailable, mainly due to planned outages.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: At around 2 pm a catastrophic failure of Callide C unit 4 reduced the amount of low priced capacity available to the market Callide B, Callide C, Stanwell and Gladstone Power Stations either went offline or had their output reduced.

interconnectors_named.name: VIC-NSW interconnector
interconnectors_named.quote: Imports from Victoria over the VIC-NSW interconnector were around 570 MW, about a third of its nominal limit, due to planned network outages in NSW and Victoria. This meant NSW could not access any more low priced capacity from Victoria.

intervals.quote: On 25 May 2021 the spot price in Queensland exceeded $5,000/MWh for the 4.30 pm to 6.30 pm trading intervals and in NSW for the 5.30 pm trading interval.

peak_price.quote: The spot price in Queensland ranged between $4,988/MWh and $15,000/MWh for the 4.30 pm to 7 pm trading intervals, and between $2,542/MWh and $6,848/MWh in NSW for the 5 pm to 6 pm trading intervals.
